continuity.rule: Continue after the final warning/monitoring scene without reusing prior panels or generic backgrounds.
continuity.characters: Keep the established FTF field-team visual identity: dark FTF jackets, practical disaster-response gear, consistent adult crew faces across panels.

storyBeat.ko: 경고를 기억한 사람들은 도시 곳곳에서 같은 약속을 실천하기 시작한다. 감시는 행동으로 이어지고, 행동은 다음 세대의 일상이 된다.
storyBeat.zh: 记住警告的人们开始在城市各处践行同一个承诺。监测化为行动，行动成为下一代的日常。
storyBeat.en: People who remember the warning begin living the same promise across the city. Monitoring becomes action, and action becomes the next generation's everyday life.

visualDirection: Polished cinematic full-color manga/webtoon page matching the approved FTF-08 reference. Real illustrated people and environments, expressive faces, cinematic lighting, dense environmental detail, no silhouettes, no stick figures, no blank SVG-card look, no recycled prior scene.

layout.action: FTF crew exits an Earth-status monitoring center into a city waking under clear dawn light; solar roofs, buses and trees are visible but secondary to the people.

caption.ko: 경고를 본 뒤, 우리는 일상으로 돌아갔다. 하지만 예전과 같은 일상은 아니었다.
caption.zh: 看见警告之后，我们回到了日常。但那已经不是从前的日常。
caption.en: After seeing the warning, we returned to daily life—but not the old daily life.

layout.action: A female FTF crew member kneels beside a school-age child planting a young tree while another crew member checks a neighborhood climate sensor in the background.

dialogue.ko: 우리가 지키는 건 오늘만이 아니야. 네가 살아갈 내일이야.
dialogue.zh: 我们守护的不只是今天，也是你将生活的明天。
dialogue.en: We're protecting more than today. We're protecting the tomorrow you'll live in.

layout.action: Residents, engineers and students work together: checking flood markers, maintaining rain gardens, sorting emergency supplies, and reviewing a public climate dashboard.

dialogue.ko: 작은 행동이 계속되면, 경고는 준비로 바뀔 수 있어.
dialogue.zh: 只要小小的行动持续下去，警告就能变成准备。
dialogue.en: When small actions continue, a warning can become preparedness.

layout.action: The FTF crew and families stand on a riverside overlook at sunset, facing a resilient green city with visible flood barriers and restored wetlands. No heroic pose; grounded, hopeful teamwork.

caption.ko: 지구의 경고를 기억하는 것. 그것이 미래를 지키는 첫 번째 약속이다.
caption.zh: 记住地球的警告，就是守护未来的第一个承诺。
caption.en: Remembering Earth's warning is the first promise we make to the future.

renderRequirements.text: Korean/Chinese/English must be legible and placed inside proper speech bubbles or narration boxes.
